call_points.text: No numeric revenue, margin or volume guidance is given for FY27 in the presentation.
Production capacity recalibrated to 9.1 lakh pairs per day from 10.5 lakh as RFL-I and II are modernised.
EBITDA margin 15.35%, up 15 bps YoY but 116 bps below Q4FY26's 16.51%.
Net debt was ₹292 Cr at FY26 versus ₹151 Cr at FY24; net worth ₹2,206 Cr.
Distribution spans ~630 distributors, ~70,000 multi-brand outlets and 429 exclusive brand outlets.
Long-term rating ICRA AA and short-term A1+ are shown in the key strengths slide.
In-house manufacturing helps maintain end-to-end quality and optimise operations.

operating_notes.text: Relaxo recommended a final dividend of ₹3.50 per share for FY26.
Relaxo approved investing up to ₹2.50 Cr for a 26% stake in a CleanMax solar captive SPV.
Total manufacturing capacity stands at approximately 10.5 lakh pairs per day.
Relaxo plans to open 100 new EBOs in FY27, adding to its existing network of over 400 EBOs.
Stated manufacturing capacity was recalibrated to 9.1 lakh pairs per day from 10.5 lakh pairs per day on 13 August 2026.
Q1FY27 average realisation per pair was ₹166 against ₹151 in Q1FY26.
Distribution covers ~630 distributors, ~70,000+ multi-brand outlets and 429 exclusive brand outlets.

timeline.summary: Mukand Lal Dua and promoter group (Usha Dua, Nikhil Dua, Ritesh Dua, Nitin Dua, Mukand Lal Dua (HUF), Pushpa Juneja, Shashi Mehra) declared no encumbrances under SEBI Takeover Regulations for FY2025-26 on April 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹751.1 Cr (+8.0% YoY), net profit ₹67.67 Cr (+20.4% YoY).
Relaxo Footwears Limited’s Board, led by Ankit Jain, recommended a final dividend of ₹3.50 per equity share (₹350% face value) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Relaxo Footwears approved an investment of up to ₹2.50 Cr for a 26% stake in a CleanMax solar SPV on May 28, 2026.
Relaxo Footwears reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹751.10 Cr (+8.05% YoY) and net profit of ₹67.67 Cr (+20.37% YoY).
Relaxo Footwears Limited shared the audio recording link for its Investors Conference Call held on May 29, 2026, at 16:00 hrs (IST), post quarterly and annual results for FY2026.
Relaxo Footwears hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 29, 2026, reporting strong volume recovery and margin expansion.

Ramesh Kumar Dua and promoter group (Lalita Dua, Gaurav Kumaar Dua, Sakshi Dua, Rahul Dua, Ramesh Kumar Dua (HUF), Pushpa Juneja, Shashi Mehra) declared no encumbrances on Relaxo Footwears’ shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(1) & (2) for FY2025-26.
Relaxo's Q1FY27 investor presentation (13 Aug 2026) showed revenue up 7.7% YoY to ₹705 Cr and PAT up 12.4% to ₹55 Cr, with stated capacity cut to 9.1 lakh pairs/day from 10.5 lakh.
Relaxo Footwears acquired a 26% stake in Clean Max MUOI Private Limited for renewable energy sourcing.

status_history.evidence: Reported Q1FY27 outlook and Q4FY26 results showing revenue growth recovery.

watchlist.response: Explained that price hikes were necessary due to steep raw material and wage cost inflation, and that price hikes were implemented across the industry.
